notes.title: KILLMAGE 1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Today we've put out an update for KILLMAGE that allows custom colors, something of an "proper" ending, and minor changes/fixes galore!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/a056615266ed8eb08796c24854f74fc485751ebe.png

Additions

 added new lines of text after killing the Immortal
 added the ability to use custom colors
 added two new color options
 added slightly more system stats
 added an option to mute the game when out of focus
 added a new secret weapon


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/c035cda81392002c4021a87f14c089fb17d7398f.png

Changes

 updated Unity version
 changed description of hyper mode to better clarify the effects
 changed the controls menu to individually list movement rebinds
 changed several minor UI components
 changed an easter egg a bit
 slightly improved color switching time


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/cdf5a1334424e99f7e51980c645dc061c03fb4aa.png

Fixes

 fixed a null reference error if starting game without a controller
 multiple fixes with the opening scene when booting game for the first time
 finally ACTUALLY fixed staff projectiles not correctly aligning with FOV


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/424a6a4ebc21f48fa7f308a1b481003e77b8533b.png

Just like always we thank everyone for the support. Also we lied in the past update, this time we actually won't be putting out more updates for KILLMAGE, unless something horribly game-breaking is found. Have a great day.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/29aba674732f21288fff3d654f3db1143158abee.png

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44926099/1fcc884fda9208223960695005032eee12ad3ecb.png

notes.title: KILLMAGE 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Today we've put out a major update for KILLMAGE that re-balances a few enemies and staffs, adds a new mini-boss, and adds a leaderboard to the Steam version!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926099/575778bd94e941998d38dc2547aacb1effca79e2.png

Additions:

     added Steam leaderboard support
     added a changelog
     added guaranteed Mass of Souls to spawn at the start of the second loop
     added a new Twisted variant for the duration of the third loop
     added a rare dog secret
     added a few sound effects
     added a few smaller graphical assets


Changes:

     changed "highscores" in the compendium to "highscores - local"
     changed the interaction prompt in the compendium to be more clear
     changed jumping height and responsiveness to be more consistent
     changed the Twisted to no longer move towards the player
     changed the Immortal's projectile attack to start with a small delay
     changed staff projectiles to correctly align with FOV
     changed the Mass of Souls to be bouncier
     changed the Hidden to now possibly hover above the player
     changed the blood staff to do extra damage after projectile bounce
     changed some UI layouts
     slightly reduced possible extra spawns in subsequent loops for Accursed
     adjusted a the aggression of enemies in subsequent loops
     adjusted a few smaller visual effects


Fixes:

     fixed time based stats & events scaling with hyper mode
     fixed the Immortal's death animation looping with hyper mode
     fixed possibly not being able to skip intro scene with controller


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926099/19e8593bc2095937c69429149a535159807071f1.png

Thank you everyone for the support, we probably won't be putting out more updates for KILLMAGE as its a pretty simple game as is and we are busy working on our next game, have a great day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926099/1fcc884fda9208223960695005032eee12ad3ecb.png
